Air has a much lower density than water, so it provides less physical support (A is false).  
Air has a higher concentration of O₂ by volume than water — about 21% in air vs. a small fraction dissolved in water (B is true).  
Air offers less resistance to motion than water (C is false).  
Air has lower specific heat capacity than water, so less thermal inertia (D is false).  

Final answer: (B)
